**Introduction**
This analysis explores the Coffee Ratings dataset from TidyTuesday. The Coffee Ratings dataset contains reviews and scores of different coffees from around the world. 

**Data Sources:**
- [TidyTuesday Coffee Ratings](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/master/data/2020/2020-07-07/readme.md)
- Original Data: [Coffee Quality Institute (CQI)](https://database.coffeeinstitute.org/) via James LeDoux.

**Analysis**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
coffee_ratings <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/master/data/2020/2020-07-07/coffee_ratings.csv')

# find the top countries by counting them
coffee_counts <- coffee_ratings |> 
  group_by(country_of_origin) |> 
  summarize(total = n()) |> 
  arrange(desc(total)) |> 
  head(10)

ggplot(data = coffee_counts, aes(x = country_of_origin, y = total)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(
    title = "Where do the most coffee ratings come from?",
    x = "Country",
    y = "Number of Ratings"
  )
```
